claim: For the natural action of \(S_4\) permuting the vertices of the tetrahedron \(\Delta^3\), the rational \(S_4\)-module \(H_4(\mathcal M(\Delta^3);\mathbb Q)\) has character values \((99,1,-1,0,-1)\) on the cycle types \((1^4),(2,1^2),(2^2),(3,1),(4)\). Consequently, \[H_4(\mathcal M(\Delta^3);\mathbb Q)\cong 4S^{(4)}\oplus13S^{(3,1)}\oplus8S^{(2,2)}\oplus12S^{(2,1,1)}\oplus4S^{(1,1,1,1)}.\]
integrity: The finite package exhaustively reconstructs the Morse complex, independently verifies its homology through an explicit acyclic matching and signed Morse boundary, then computes the \(S_4\) character directly from signed chain traces. Literature searches are evidence for originality, not a proof of exhaustive novelty.
scientific_limitations: The computation determines the rational \(S_4\)-module on fourth homology, not the full equivariant homotopy type or an integral symmetry-adapted basis. No statement is made for higher-dimensional simplices.
title: The \(S_4\)-character of tetrahedral Morse-complex homology
